name: Canyon Ranch Tucson
positioning: All-inclusive wellness resort in Arizona's Sonoran Desert, Canyon Ranch's flagship destination
best_for: Travelers who want an all-inclusive wellness and spa stay
Guests who want daily activities, spa services and wellness programs in one place

facts.text: Canyon Ranch Tucson is the brand's flagship destination and an all-inclusive wellness resort.
The resort is set in Arizona's Sonoran Desert.
The resort is at 8600 E Rockcliff Road in Tucson, Arizona.
Guests have access to the spa and fitness amenities, including whirlpools and cold plunges.
Services span spa and beauty, fitness and movement, health and performance, and mind and spirit.
The spa menu includes Ayurvedic treatments.
The spa menu includes a Watsu aquatic massage.
Designed Experiences are stay packages with a specific wellness focus, such as Get Healthy, Mindful Journey and Adrenaline Junkie.
Round-trip transportation is always included in a stay.
Chef-crafted dining is always included in a stay.
Groups of 8 or more can book at a special rate.

highlights.text: The Michelin Guide 2026 named Canyon Ranch Tucson the #1 Wellness Resort in the Americas.
Four pools and hydrotherapy are always included in a stay.
More than 35 optional activities are offered daily and are always included.
The All You Can Spa package allows unlimited services from over 30 of the spa's offerings.

considerations.text: Events and retreats are limited-time, expert-led group events, so they run only on set dates.
WhataHotel notes the wellness-focused environment may not appeal to traditional leisure travelers.
WhataHotel notes the desert location requires adjustment to arid climate conditions.
